research.title: The rise of content as data: How AI is reshaping market insights
research.summary: In this episode of Making Sense, product specialist Edwina Lowe speaks with Camila Penna, co-head of Global Cash Equity Sales, about how AI is reshaping the way institutional investors consume information from the sell side. Research, market commentary and other unstructured content is increasingly being fed directly into data platforms and AI workflows, rather than simply read by individuals. They explore what this shift means for the investment landscape, including how the role of content authors and the value of their content may evolve, how firms think about access and intellectual property and what happens as machines increasingly become the "front-line" consumers of content.
